## Evidence rules (#M-4)
Every claim tool-backed with quoted output. Design-conformance claims must cite the design section they implement.

## Privacy rules (binding)
- The PR body references the CLOSED public companion issue #5921 for context. It must NOT reference the private issue number, paste any private issue text, private absolute paths, or FX-07 canary values. Public tests keep using the synthetic slug and the public-safe canary token only.
- Do not widen the private-payload admit contract, do not add any private field collection, do not write source_id=private-local-adapter into location.search.

Your scope is EXACTLY its §15.2 rows R-UI-1, R-UI-2, R-UI-3, R-TEST-1 (public tests only), R-TEST-2 — with §15.3 as hard prohibitions and §14's residual notes (FX-02 card counts, FX-08 focus-restoration assertion if missing, FX-09 no-URL-leak) as the acceptance details.
2. Work ONLY in your dispatch worktree (public repo).
3. Tests: annotate existing public tests with their FX ids per R-TEST-1; add the R-TEST-2 source-blind browser proof (stale public + healthy private ⇒ public stays stale/UNKNOWN); keep everything source-blind and fixture-based.
4. Run affected pytest + ruff. Conventional commit(s), push, open ONE focused PR (title references the Work board arc; body context = public #5921).
5. Do NOT arm auto-merge and do NOT merge. The driver handles review + merge.
